name: agent-platform
description: Runs coding agents for a team behind boundaries they cannot move: an LLM gateway (LiteLLM teams, budgets, deny-by-default MCP grants), scoped read-only agent tools enforced in the data proxy (vmauth extra_label, proven by replay and attack), and Claude Code usage telemetry with the organisation boundary in the collector. Ships an MCP grant probe and a collector-filter tester.
